_how: Fill in your drones under designs (a CAD file + numbers), then the deployment. Run: python3 lab/check.py lab/fleet.json. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

auv._what: kind: uuv under water, usv on the water, uav over it. layout (uuv only): torpedo, glider or vectored6. Leave mass out for a sub to make it neutrally buoyant.
auv._units: units: auto (guess), mm, cm, m or in. forward/up: which file axis is the nose and which is up.
auv._structure: material: al6061 ti6al4v ss316 cfrp gfrp abs pla petg hdpe pmma pom

deployment._what: design: a name from designs above, or an example (sample-petrel, sample-tern, sample-quad, sample-torpedo, sample-wigley). start: [lat, lon, depth or altitude in m].
deployment.name: AUV survey with a boat overhead

links._what: a and b must stay within max_m (horizontal or 3d) for at least need of the time
